title: Live Terminal Restart and Single Control Ownership for Control Panel
specification:
# PRD: Live Terminal Restart and Single Control Ownership for Control Panel

Priority: high

## Problem
The current control-plane restart flow relaunches the bridge as a detached background process, so managers cannot directly watch the relaunched process in the control panel. The UI shows status and PID evidence, but not a live terminal. The repo also does not appear to enforce exclusive control ownership per repo session, which can lead to multiple open panels competing to operate the same repo.

## Goal
Make restart behavior visible and trustworthy by launching into a live terminal/process panel instead of a detached background process, and add optional per-repo exclusive control ownership so only one control-panel session can operate lifecycle controls at a time.

## Requirements
- Replace detached bridge restart behavior with a managed live process terminal/session that is visible in the control panel.
- Show live stdout/stderr, running status, and current PID for the managed server/bridge process in the control panel.
- Preserve restart evidence showing old PID to new PID after a restart.
- Define startup behavior when a managed process for the same repo/target already exists, including clear user-visible messaging and expected replacement/refusal rules.
- Add optional per-repo exclusive control ownership so only one control-panel session can use control actions at a time.
- Allow non-owner sessions to remain open in read-only mode with clear indication of who owns controls and how takeover works.
- Ensure server and bridge lifecycle semantics are explicitly defined rather than relying on incidental behavior such as port collisions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- After triggering a bridge restart, the control panel opens or focuses a live terminal/process panel for that repo target instead of only showing a detached background relaunch.
- The live panel shows process output, current PID, and running/stopped state without requiring shell access.
- A completed restart displays normalized restart evidence including preRestartPid and postRestartPid when replacement succeeds.
- If a process already exists for the repo/target, the product follows the documented singleton/replacement rule and shows a clear message to the manager.
- When exclusive control ownership is enabled, only one active session can use repo control actions; other sessions are read-only until takeover occurs.
- The UI clearly indicates owner session state and takeover outcome for concurrent control-panel sessions.

## Verification
- Unit tests for restart result normalization, singleton/ownership rules, and PID evidence generation.
- Integration coverage for bridge restart into live terminal session and control-panel state refresh.
- Manual verification that restart opens a live process view, shows output, and records PID change evidence.
- Manual verification that two open panels for the same repo respect exclusive control ownership and takeover behavior.
